title: Chamber Block Clear
description: Outsmart tight stone-chamber puzzles by sliding interlocking jewel blocks toward matching exits before the move counter runs out.
controls: Drag colored chamber blocks across the grid to match them with same-color perimeter exits and clear every tile.

zh-CN.title: 密室方块大消除
zh-CN.description: 烧脑华容道式密室推块消除：在狭小机关密室里巧挪异形彩块，对准边缘同色出口逐个粉碎清屏。
zh-CN.controls: 手指拖动彩色方块在棋盘内移动，贴近同色边缘出口即可消除，清空所有方块过关。
